events.description: 2. ORDER (Directing Defendants to File a Response) This matter comes before the Court on the "Petition for an Emergency Injunctive Relief and a Writ of Mandamus and Prohibition and a Permanent Mandatory Injunctive Relief," (ECF No. 1 (the "Petition")), which asserts that Virginia state officials "have violated and continue to violate the [Petitioners]' substantial federal voting rights." (Id. at 7 .) The Court hereby ORDERS that Defendants respond to the Petition no later than noon on November 1, 2024. Petitioners may file a reply no later than noon on November 4, 2024. Let the Clerk file a copy of this Order electronically, notify all counsel of record and send a copy to the address of record for each of the named Defendants. Signed by District Judge David J. Novak on 10/29/2024. (adun, ) (Entered: 10/29/2024)
